metadata.title: The centered logarithmic Brunn--Minkowski inequality
metadata.abstract: The logarithmic Brunn--Minkowski and logarithmic Minkowski inequalities are proved for convex bodies whose centroids are at the origin, with equality precisely for independent positive dilations of common direct summands. This characterizes when centered convex bodies have the same cone-volume measure. The \(L_p\) Brunn--Minkowski and Minkowski inequalities are also obtained for every \(p>0\), with equality only for positive dilates, and the corresponding uniqueness of centered \(L_p\) surface area measures is established.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 作者的 Theorems 1.1–1.5 宣称 centered log-Brunn–Minkowski/log-Minkowski、cone-volume ambiguity 与 p>0 的 Lₚ inequalities。证明以 Ψ(C)=minξ∫C exp(−〈ξ,x〉)dx，在全部 Wulff support 上建立 log Ψ concavity；moment coordinate 中去除 affine function 的 variance estimate 与 retained matrix remainder 用于等号。
analysis.breakthrough: 若 projected variance 与 limiting rigidity 成立，将处理普通 centroid condition 下不要求 symmetry 的 logarithmic 端点。
analysis.limitations: centered class 不在 Wulff interpolation 下封闭，因此优化功能的全域 concavity 是关键。logarithmic 等号允许非正交共同 direct summands；Lₚ surface measure uniqueness 在 p=n 只到 dilation，不能说全 p 均唯一。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者明确披露全文证明均由 ChatGPT 生成，AI 还用于多轮 adversarial checking。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者明确披露全文证明均由 ChatGPT 生成，AI 还用于多轮 adversarial checking。

analysis.priorityReason: 若论证成立，将解决 centered 版本的核心凸几何猜想。
